name: Valley Humane Society Volunteers
what_you_do: You care for shelter cats and dogs, help in the treatment room, assist staff or help with media. You work one set shift each week.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 or older. Some jobs need you to be 18. These are AniMeals, customer service and events. Parent and child volunteering is not offered.
pay_detail: Unpaid. New volunteers buy a $30 Volunteer Starter Kit with a shirt, name badge and manuals.
duration: Most roles ask for one shift a week for six months to one year
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline. You apply for an open shift.
how_to_apply: Look at the open shifts and apply for one you can work. A volunteer coordinator then contacts you to set up an orientation. You also take role workshops and shadow shifts.
notes: Students can earn community service hours with the same six month, weekly shift promise. Court ordered hours are not accepted. Volunteers must be fully vaccinated, according to the FAQ. Sunday dog care is the greatest need.
